crossRefs.note: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around…
Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height…

translations.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
translations.bsb: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
translations.asv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
